descriptions.notStarted: #p1002001# has noticed that #p20000# has been acting weird lately. You'd better head over to Lith Harbor and talk to #p1002001# to see what's up.
descriptions.inProgress: Apparently, #p20000# started displaying some strange behavior ever since he started carrying some wooden box with him. Your task now is to investigate the wooden box that's next to #p20000#.
descriptions.completed: As you promised to #p20000#, you did not reveal to #p1002001# that the wooden box contained medication for arthritis.
